title: millefolium
intro: Millefolium, commonly known as Yarrow, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family, characterized by its fern-like leaves and small white or yellow flowers. The health benefits of Yarrow include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and ease menstrual cramps, while also acting as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent. The therapeutic actions of Yarrow include its ability to stimulate digestion, promote sweating, and relieve spasms, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Yarrow include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
